name: Umber Eclipse Targe
description: Round shield with a dark disc that swallows light. Once per long rest, as a reaction to a spell attack or a spell that requires a Precision roll, you gain +5 AC and advantage on that save.

effects.name: Lightswallow Guard
effects.text: Once per short rest, as a reaction to a spell attack or a spell that requires a DEX save, gain +5 AC and advantage on that save.

name: Ochrehide Jerkin
description: Tanned hide stained with Ochre clay; a road-warden staple.

name: Lupine Trailcoat
description: Fur-trimmed leather cut for long runs in Lupine country.

name: Vellari Gauze Wrap
description: Layered gauze bands the Vellari wear under travel robes.

name: Sablethread Doublet
description: Black quilted doublet with corded seams.

name: Graniar Quarry Apron
description: Heavy canvas apron with slate inserts, worn by Graniar cutters.

name: Skyborn Gliding Leathers
description: Close-fitted leathers with webbed underarms.

name: Dewlight Jerkin
description: Pale leather that beads with dew at dawn. Once per long rest, when you would be blinded, you can use your reaction to ignore it until the end of your next turn.

name: Cinderfoot Leathers
description: Soot-dark leather from the Gehennan borderlands. You take no damage from walking on hot ground, embers or burning terrain, and you have advantage on saves against being knocked prone.

name: Whisperstep Vest
description: Felted vest that drinks sound. Opportunity attacks against you are made with disadvantage if you moved at least 10 ft this turn.

name: Thornmoss Wrap
description: Living moss over leather; it prickles when grabbed. When a creature grapples you, it takes 1d4 piercing damage.

name: Lupine Ridgehide
description: Layered wolf-hide with a raised spine ridge.

name: Graniar Slate Lamellar
description: Thin slate plates laced in rows; it clacks.

name: Ochre Drifter's Coat
description: Dust-coloured greatcoat that seems to blur at the hem. Your walking speed can't be reduced by difficult terrain made of sand, mud or snow, and once per short rest you can take the Dash action as a bonus action.

effects.name: Dustblur Stride
effects.text: Nonmagical difficult terrain doesn't reduce your walking speed. Once per short rest, Dash as a bonus action; opportunity attacks against you have disadvantage until the end of that turn.

name: Umbral Veilcoat
description: Umber-dyed silk that pools with shadow. While in dim light or darkness you can take the Hide action as a bonus action. Once per short rest, when hit, you can use your reaction to become heavily obscured to that attacker until the start of your next turn (it has disadvantage on further attacks).

effects.name: Shadowpool Cloak
effects.text: In dim light or darkness you can Hide as a bonus action. Once per short rest, when hit, use your reaction to become heavily obscured to that attacker until the start of your next turn (it has disadvantage on further attacks). The obscurement applies to all attackers.

name: Umberwood Scale
description: Hardened dark-wood scales over leather.

name: Vellari Lacquered Coat
description: Lacquered panels on a Vellari riding coat.

name: Ochre Clay Cuirass
description: Fired-clay breastplate on a padded backing.

name: Marchwarden Brigandine
description: Canvas-covered plates riveted for border patrols.

name: Saltglass Scale
description: Scales of fused coastal glass. You have resistance to acid damage from every source, and advantage on saves against being poisoned.

name: Stormhide Lamellar
description: Hide plates from beasts of the high storms. When you are hit by a lightning attack, you can halve the damage (reaction, 1/short rest).

name: Bramblewarden Coat
description: Woven bramble over hide; it shifts like a hedge. You can't be pushed or pulled more than 5 ft against your will.

name: Hearthcoal Brigandine
description: Plates warmed from within by a coal-red lining. You suffer no penalties from extreme cold, and once per long rest you can end the frightened condition on yourself as a bonus action.

name: Graniar Oathstone
description: Shield cut from a stone sworn upon by Graniar elders. You have advantage on Might and Endurance rolls while the shield is held.

effects.name: Eldersworn Grip
effects.text: Advantage on STR and CON saves while the shield is held.

effects.name: Oathbound Brace
effects.text: +1 AC. One ally within 5 ft also gains advantage on STR saves. Resistance to thunder damage.

name: Ochre Sunscale
description: Burnished scales the colour of an Ochre noon. Twice per long rest, as a reaction when hit, you flare: the attacker is blinded until the end of its next turn (Endurance roll vs 8 + proficiency + Endurance).

effects.name: Noonflare Retort
effects.text: Twice per long rest, as a reaction when hit, flare: the attacker is blinded until the end of its next turn (CON save vs 8 + proficiency + CON).

effects.name: Sunscale Glare
effects.text: +1 AC. Resistance to radiant damage.

name: Bellwether Plate
description: Plate with a small bronze bell at the gorget. As a bonus action (1/short rest), each enemy within 10 ft must make a Judgment roll or have disadvantage on attacks against creatures other than you until your next turn.

name: Cragwall Carapace
description: Rough Graniar granite plates. When you take the Dodge action you also gain temporary HP equal to your Endurance modifier.

name: Graniar Stoneplate
description: Hammered plates backed with flat stone, Graniar-made.

name: Sable Iron Hauberk
description: Blackened iron mail to the shin.

name: Ochre Bulwark Harness
description: Thick ochre-painted plate for siege lines.

name: Gehenna Slag Mail
description: Rings drawn from Gehennan slag; heavy and coarse.

name: Umber Banded Coat
description: Banded iron strips over dark leather.

name: Vellari Gatewarden Plate
description: Ceremonial plate of the Vellari gate guards.

name: Ironroot Splint
description: Splints grown from iron-hard roots. You have advantage on saves against being knocked prone or pushed.

name: Frostfen Hauberk
description: Mail rimed with frost that never melts. You suffer no penalties from extreme cold and you can't be slowed by ice or snow.

name: Kite Shield
description: Tapered shield for mounted work.

name: Spiked Buckler
description: Small shield; can catch a blade.

name: Runic Targe
description: Round shield etched with ward-lines.

name: Tidewall Shield
description: Blue-lacquered shield that sheds water. You have advantage on Precision rolls against effects you can see while this shield is raised.

name: Lupine Hide Targe
description: Round hide shield on a bent-wood frame.

name: Graniar Slab Shield
description: A cut slab of stone with a strap; brutal to carry.

name: Ochre Oval Shield
description: Painted oval shield of ochre-dyed planks.

name: Umber Ironrim Shield
description: Dark oak shield bound in iron.

name: Skyborn Wingbuckler
description: Feather-shaped buckler of light bone.

name: Vellari Crescent Shield
description: Crescent-cut shield used by Vellari cavalry.

name: Thornback Buckler
description: Buckler grown from a briar knot. When a creature misses you with a melee attack, it takes 1d4 piercing damage (1/turn).

name: Sable Hushguard
description: Felt-faced black shield; blows land dull. Once per short rest, when hit by a critical hit, you can use your reaction to reduce the damage by 1d8.

name: Bastion Pavise
description: Tall standing shield with a fold-out brace. As a bonus action you can plant it: until you move, you and one adjacent ally gain half cover.

name: Padded Cloth
description: Quilted layers; quiet and light.

name: Leather Harness
description: Boiled leather straps over cloth.

name: Hide Coat
description: Thick hide; dex bonus capped at +2.

name: Scale Shirt
description: Overlapping scales; noisy.

name: Chain Hauberk
description: No dex to AC; needs strong frame.

name: Plate Harness
description: Full plates; max mundane protection.

name: Wooden Shield
description: Add as shieldMod while equipped.

name: Iron Buckler
description: Small shield; lighter cover.

name: Travel Cloak Lining
description: Reinforced lining under a traveler’s cloak.

name: River Reed Wrap
description: Woven reeds; light and quiet near water.

name: Softsuede Vest
description: Supple suede panels over the torso.

name: Brigand Straps
description: Layered leather straps favored by road thieves.

name: Umber Silk Mail
description: Dark silk with thin hidden plates.

name: Scout’s Jack
description: Short jacket with discreet bone stays.

name: Bark Mantle
description: Cured bark scales; forest hunters’ wear.

name: Bone Lamellar
description: Laced bone plates; light rattle.

name: Ringweave Coat
description: Cloth coat sewn with iron rings.

name: Bronze Scale
description: Warm-toned scales; flashy and loud.

name: Horned Cuirass
description: Hard cuirass with ceremonial horns.

name: Ashen Brigandine
description: Plates riveted under grey canvas.

name: Iron Hauberk
description: Standard iron mail to the knee.

name: Splint March
description: Vertical splints for long campaigns.

name: Knight’s Plate
description: Full harness; parade and battle.

name: Obsidian Carapace
description: Volcanic glass plates; brittle but hard.

name: Tower Shield
description: Huge shield; great cover, hard to hide.

name: Gehennan Ashscale
description: Grey scales that flake like cooled ash. You have resistance to fire damage. When a creature hits you with a melee attack while you are bloodied, it takes fire damage equal to your Proficiency Bonus.

effects.name: Cinderskin Rebuke
effects.text: Resistance to fire. When a creature hits you with a melee attack while you are bloodied, it takes fire damage equal to your proficiency bonus. The retaliation also applies while you are not bloodied, once per round.

name: Sable Wolfguard Harness
description: Lupine war-harness of sable steel and fur. While an ally is within 5 ft of you, you and that ally gain +1 to saving throws. Once per long rest, as a reaction to a crit against you, turn it into a normal hit.

effects.name: Packbond Guard
effects.text: While an ally is within 5 ft of you, you and that ally gain +1 to saving throws. Once per long rest, as a reaction to a crit against you, turn it into a normal hit.

effects.name: Wolfguard Brace
effects.text: +1 AC. The save bonus range is 10 ft.

name: Gehennan Furnaceplate
description: Plate that glows dull red at the joints. Resistance to fire damage. Once per long rest, as an action, you vent heat: creatures within 10 ft make a Precision roll (8 + proficiency + Endurance) or take 3d6 fire damage, half on a success.

effects.name: Ventheat Burst
effects.text: Resistance to fire. Once per long rest, as an action, vent heat: creatures within 10 ft make a DEX save (DC 8 + proficiency + CON) or take 4d6 fire damage, half on a success.

name: Gehennan Brandshield
description: Iron face scorched with a Gehennan mark. Once per short rest, when you block with your reaction, the attacker takes 2d6 fire damage.

effects.name: Scorchmark Block
effects.text: Once per short rest, when you block with your reaction, the attacker takes 3d6 fire damage.

name: Ochre Warden Wall
description: A great rectangular shield of ochre-banded steel. Allies adjacent to you gain +1 AC against ranged attacks.

effects.name: Bannerwall Screen
effects.text: Allies within 10 ft of you gain +1 AC against ranged attacks.

name: Sable Vigil Plate
description: Black plate whose wearer never sleeps deeply. You can't be surprised, and you have advantage on initiative.

effects.name: Wakeful Sentinel
effects.text: You can't be surprised and have advantage on initiative. Allies within 10 ft also can't be surprised. Add your proficiency bonus to initiative.

name: Skyborn Windcuirass
description: Light cuirass vented with feather-shaped slits. You have advantage on Stealth checks. Once per long rest, as a bonus action, you become invisible until the end of your next turn or until you attack.

effects.name: Ventwing Vanish
effects.text: Advantage on Shadowing checks. Once per long rest, as a bonus action, become invisible until the end of your next turn or until you attack.

name: Umber Mirecoat
description: Dark oilcloth plates that shed water and grime. You have advantage on saves against being restrained or grappled, and once per short rest you can use a bonus action to escape a grapple automatically.

effects.name: Slipgrime Escape
effects.text: Advantage on saves against being restrained or grappled. Once per short rest, use a bonus action to escape a grapple automatically. The escape also ends being restrained.

name: Umbercrown Harness
description: Plate crowned with umber horns at the pauldrons. Once per short rest, when an ally within 5 ft is hit, you can use your reaction to become the target instead.

effects.name: Hornguard Intercept
effects.text: Once per short rest, when an ally within 10 ft is hit, use your reaction to move to their side without provoking and become the target instead.

name: Graniar Mountainheart
description: Plate carved from a single seam of mountain ore. You can't be moved against your will, and once per long rest you can reduce damage from one hit to 0 (reaction).

effects.name: Rootstone Stand
effects.text: You can't be moved against your will. Once per long rest, as a reaction, reduce damage from one hit to 0.

effects.name: Bedrock Bulwark
effects.text: +1 AC. Resistance to bludgeoning damage.

name: Radiant Dawnweave
description: Gold-white cloth woven by Radiant hands. Twice per long rest, when an ally within 30 ft takes damage, you can use your reaction to take half of it instead. You can't be charmed while conscious.

effects.name: Shared Burden Weave
effects.text: You can't be charmed while conscious. Twice per long rest, when an ally within 30 ft takes damage, use your reaction to take half of it instead.

effects.name: Radiant Weft
effects.text: +1 AC. You have resistance to the redirected damage.

name: Radiant Haloshield
description: Disc shield ringed by a faint halo. Twice per long rest, as a reaction when a creature within 30 ft is hit, grant it +3 AC against that attack, possibly turning it into a miss.

effects.name: Haloring Deflect
effects.text: Twice per long rest, as a reaction when a creature within 30 ft is hit, grant it +3 AC against that attack, possibly turning it into a miss.

effects.name: Haloed Rim
effects.text: +1 AC. Your Haloring Deflect grants +4 AC instead of +3.

name: Radiant Lanternplate
description: White-gold plate that hums with a held breath of light. Allies within 10 ft have advantage on saves against being frightened. Twice per long rest, as a reaction when an ally within 10 ft takes damage, they gain temporary HP equal to your level before the damage applies.

effects.name: Lanternheart Hum
effects.text: Allies within 10 ft have advantage on saves against being frightened. Twice per long rest, as a reaction when an ally within 10 ft takes damage, they gain temporary HP equal to your level before the damage applies.

effects.name: Lanternlight Shell
effects.text: +1 AC. Allies in the aura can't be frightened.

name: Aegis of the Last Ember
description: Plate said to hold the final ember of a fallen sun. Resistance to radiant and necrotic damage. Once per long rest, when you are reduced below half HP, you regain HP equal to twice your level and enemies within 10 ft are pushed 10 ft.

effects.name: Final Sunrise
effects.text: Resistance to radiant and necrotic damage. Once per long rest, when reduced below half HP (but not to 0), regain HP equal to twice your level and push enemies within 10 ft 10 ft away.

effects.name: Sunfall Brace
effects.text: Enemies pushed by your Last Ember surge take 4d6 radiant damage.

effects.name: Last Light Bastion
effects.text: +2 AC.

name: Bulwark of the Hollow Sky
description: A sky-pale shield that weighs nothing. Once per long rest, as a reaction, you and allies within 10 ft are immune to all damage from one attack or effect. You can't be flanked.

effects.name: Skyhollow Shelter
effects.text: You can't be flanked. Once per long rest, as a reaction, you and allies within 10 ft take no damage from one attack or effect.

effects.name: Hollow Sky Ward
effects.text: Resistance to force damage, and your no-damage reaction covers allies within 20 ft.

effects.name: Skyweight Bastion
effects.text: +2 AC.

name: Coat of the Unbroken Pack
description: Hide of the first Lupine pack-mother, never pierced. You have resistance to bludgeoning, piercing and slashing damage while bloodied. Once per long rest, as a bonus action, allies within 30 ft gain temporary HP equal to your level.

effects.name: Packmother's Hide
effects.text: Resistance to bludgeoning, piercing and slashing damage while bloodied. Once per long rest, as a bonus action, allies within 30 ft gain temporary HP equal to your level.

effects.name: Pack Rally
effects.text: Your rally grants temporary HP equal to twice your level.

effects.name: Unbroken Hide Bastion
effects.text: +2 AC.

name: Sable Nightskin
description: Supple armor of sable-black hide that never reflects light. Ranged attacks against you have disadvantage while you are more than 30 ft from the attacker.

effects.name: Distant Shade
effects.text: Ranged attacks against you have disadvantage while you are more than 30 ft from the attacker.

effects.name: Unreflecting Hide
effects.text: +1 AC. Distance threshold 20 ft. Advantage on Shadowing checks in dim light or darkness.

name: Moonfeather Mantle
description: Skyborn flight-feathers sewn over a leather spine. You take no falling damage from falls of 60 ft or less, and once per long rest you can glide: for 10 rounds in combat, or 1 minute out of combat, you descend 60 ft per round and move 2 ft horizontally per 1 ft fallen. [LOCKED]

effects.name: Featherfall Glide
effects.text: No falling damage from falls of 60 ft or less. Once per long rest you can glide for 10 rounds in combat, or 1 minute out of combat: descend 60 ft per round and move 2 ft horizontally per 1 ft fallen; while gliding you take no falling damage from any height.

name: Vestment of the First Dawn
description: Said to have been worn before the Ochre sky first broke. You have resistance to necrotic and radiant damage. Once per long rest, as a bonus action, you shed dawnlight for 10 rounds in combat, or 1 minute out of combat: you and allies within 10 ft regain HP equal to your Proficiency Bonus at the start of each of your turns, and can't be frightened. [LOCKED]

effects.name: Dawnbreak Mantle
effects.text: Resistance to necrotic and radiant damage. Once per long rest, as a bonus action, shed dawnlight for 10 rounds in combat, or 1 minute out of combat: you and allies within 10 ft regain HP equal to your proficiency bonus at the start of each of your turns (only while above 0 HP) and can't be frightened.

effects.name: Spreading Dawn
effects.text: Your dawnlight aura reaches 20 ft.

effects.name: First Light Bastion
effects.text: +2 AC.
